walkoverModal.title: Walkover
walkoverModal.resultForfeitHelp: No-show, more than 5 minutes late, or a serious violation. Every set is recorded with the walkover score (default 11:0) and points already won are voided.
walkoverModal.resultRetiredHelp: Giving up during the match, e.g. injury. Points and sets already won are kept, the set in progress goes to the opponent, and remaining sets are 0:11. (The handling can be changed in the competition rules.)

timeLimit.help: With a time limit the referee screen shows a match clock. The clock stops during warm-up, side changes and time-outs (player, referee, medical); rally time counts.
timeLimit.minutesHelp: Enter a whole number from 1 to 240.
timeLimit.unitHelp: When time is up: per set, the side leading the set wins it. Whole match, the side leading the current set takes it and the side with more sets wins (equal sets: the side that took that set). A tie goes to golden goal.
timeLimit.nextPoint: Next point (IBSA default, foul points count)
timeLimit.goalOnly: Next goal (2 points) only (foul points count but do not decide)
timeLimit.goldenHelp: Golden goal starts after a coin toss for serve.
timeLimit.roundHelp: Leave empty to follow the stage setting; 0 means no time limit from that round.
timeLimit.ibsaHelp: IBSA forbids time-limited matches at sanctioned events. When on, you are warned if a time limit is used.
timeLimit.ibsaWarning: Warning: time-limited matches are not allowed at IBSA-sanctioned events. Time limit used in: {{scopes}}. You can still save.

rulesEditor.title: Competition rules
rulesEditor.intro: All competition rules used by this tournament. There is no standard format: presets are only a starting point, so review every value and change what you need.

scope.label: Settings scope
scope.help: Set the tournament-wide values, then choose a stage to change only the values that differ for that stage.
scope.overrideCount: Values in this stage that differ from the tournament: {{count}}
scope.noOverride: Every value in this stage follows the tournament value.
scope.hiddenNote: Hidden because this stage does not use them: {{fields}}. Set these for the whole tournament (or in the stage that uses them).

override.notUsed: This stage does not use this value. Reset it to the tournament value.

preset.note: A preset is only a starting point. After choosing one, press 'Fill values' to replace the tournament-wide values with the preset. Values the preset defines (tiebreak order, how 3rd and 5th–8th places are decided) take precedence over the third-place and 5th–8th match choices from earlier steps. Sets, qualifiers and stage overrides are kept. Review every value afterwards.
preset.apply: Fill values from the selected preset
preset.applied: Filled values from the {{name}} preset. Tournament-wide edits were cleared.

descriptions.ibsa: Points → head-to-head → set difference → point difference → points scored, third-place match. (Provisional until the IBSA text is confirmed)
descriptions.simple: Points → set difference → point difference, joint third place, no placement matches.
descriptions.custom: Start from the base defaults and set every value yourself.

scoring.winScoreHelp: Usually 11 for individual and 31 for team matches.
scoring.winBy2: A set must be won by 2 points
scoring.winBy2Help: When off, the first side to reach the target wins the set even by 1 point.

round.toggle: Change sets per match from a given round
round.help: Applies to finals bracket matches only. Example: groups, round of 16 and quarterfinals best of 3; best of 5 from the semifinals. The third-place match counts as the final round. Per-match rules will come with later engine work.
round.bestOf: Sets per match from that round

scoring.servesPerTurnHelp: How many serves in a row before the serve passes to the opponent.
scoring.sideChangeAtHelp: In the deciding set (including single-set matches), ends are changed when one side reaches this score. In other sets, ends are changed after the set.
scoring.playersOnCourtHelp: How many players of one team play at the same time.
scoring.serveRotationHelp: Separate with commas. A is the team serving first in the set, B the other team, and the number is the player order. The two teams must alternate. Leave empty for the default order ({{example}}).
scoring.autoHelp: Leave empty to use the default ({{value}}).

standings.help: Points in the standings. The 'points' tiebreak criterion uses these values.

walkover.help: IBSA distinction — default loss (no-show, more than 5 minutes late, serious violation): every set is 11:0 and points already won are voided. Retirement (giving up, e.g. injury): points and sets already won are kept, the set in progress goes to the opponent, and the remaining sets are 0:11.
walkover.scoreTarget: Use the set target score (11:0 individual, 31:0 team)
walkover.countInStandings: Count walkovers in the standings (points, sets, scores)
walkover.byeCountsAsWalkover: Record a bye (no opponent) as a walkover
walkover.retirementVoid: Like a default loss: void points won, walkover score for every set
walkover.retirementRecorded: Keep the recorded scores as they are and record a loss for the retiring side

tiebreak.help: Applied from the top down. Use the 'Move up' and 'Move down' buttons to change the order.
tiebreak.none: No criteria. Add at least one.
tiebreak.allAdded: All criteria are in the list.
tiebreak.h2hRecursive: Reapply: when only some are separated, restart from the first criterion among those still tied
tiebreak.h2hSingle: Single pass: continue with the next criterion for those still tied
tiebreak.unresolvedLegend: If still tied at the end
tiebreak.unresolvedLot: Draw lots (a stored seed gives the same result again)
tiebreak.preview: Ties are broken by {{order}}. If still tied, {{last}}.

qualification.wildcardsHelp: Extra qualifiers chosen by record from the next place in each group. 0 means no wildcards (none are added automatically).
qualification.avoidSameGroup: Keep players from the same group apart in the first finals round

schedule.minRestHelp: Measured from the planned end of the previous match (start + match length) to the start of the next (not start to start). Automatic scheduling keeps this rest; for team matches it applies to every member, and bracket matches wait for their source matches (e.g. quarterfinals) to end.

fields.scoring-individual-winScore: Individual points to win a set
fields.scoring-team-winScore: Team points to win a set

errors.bestOfOdd: Sets per match must be odd (1, 3, 5…).
errors.tiebreakEmpty: At least one tiebreak criterion is needed.
errors.roundFrom: Choose the round to start from.
errors.confirmRequired: Confirm that you have reviewed the rules.
errors.sideChangeRange: Must be lower than the points to win a set (at most {{max}}).
errors.rotationInvalid: Use team letters (A/B) with player numbers 1–{{players}}, alternating teams, e.g. A1, B1.

impact.started: Some matches have started or finished. Saving recomputes standings and qualifiers with the new rules.
impact.finals: The finals (or placement) bracket already exists. Changing the rules does not change matches already created, so qualifiers and standings may no longer match the bracket. You will be asked to confirm when saving.
impact.confirmMessage: The finals bracket already exists. Save the rules anyway? Standings and qualifiers are recomputed with the new rules, but matches already created do not change.

save.queued: Not saved on the server yet. Kept on this device and will be sent again when the connection returns. Please check that it was applied.
save.failed: Could not save the rules. Someone else may have changed the tournament first, or the connection dropped. Check the screen and try again.
save.changedElsewhere: The rules were changed elsewhere (another admin or the chatbot) while you were editing. Those changes are now shown. Saving writes only the items you changed and keeps the rest. If both changed the same item, your value is saved.

wizard.confirm: I have reviewed all of the competition rules above
